question: Will the channel and security owners approve this exact dependency-changing head as an official credential-bearing Buzz channel plugin?
rationale: The patch adds a new third-party relay runtime, private-key and delegated-auth handling, and an official catalog entry; repository policy and the PR’s dependency guard reserve that acceptance for human owners.

options.title: Authorize the reviewed plugin head
options.body: Security approves the exact dependency graph and a channel owner sponsors Buzz after reviewing redacted live relay proof.

options.title: Keep Buzz community-published
options.body: Decline the official catalog path and ask for the package to remain an independently published plugin until a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Authorize the reviewed plugin head
recommendation.body: Security approves the exact dependency graph and a channel owner sponsors Buzz after reviewing redacted live relay proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s dependency guard specifically names this owner for exact-head authorization of dependency graph changes.
